correctness.rationale: Inspected the exact definition on the hex norm \(N(s,t)=\max\{|s|,|t|,|s-t|\}\), scale and parameter interchange invariance, and the plane embedding into a three-coordinate sup-norm space. For distinct active coordinates, the dual unit-ball six vertices imply signed two-functional norms \(a+b\) and \(\max(a,b)\) in opposite sign choices; independently checked six ordered pairs on twenty positive rational coefficient choices. Weighted AM--GM and Cauchy--Schwarz reduce the sharp upper bound to minimizing \(G_1(z)\) for \(z\le1/r\) and \(G_2(z)\) for \(z\ge1/r\); the unconstrained minimum \(z=\sqrt{1+r^2}\) crosses the boundary exactly when \(r^4+r^2=1\). Checked both explicit attaining families at \(r=0.04,0.2,0.5,0.75,r_*,0.9,1\); direct evaluation matched both closed forms including \(C_Z(1,1)=5/4\). These samples supplement the universal analytic argument and the source symbolic verifier.
